highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 moves to Skia m157 with image-filter, glyph and GPU rendering corrections.
highlights_body: The release also makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit without changing public API signatures. Graphite Metal users should check the updated native iOS and tvOS runtime minimum.

breaking.title: Check the Graphite Metal runtime minimum
breaking.body: Graphite Metal now requires iOS or tvOS 15; its macOS minimum remains 12. Raise deployment requirements to meet these native minimums when using Graphite Metal. Higher managed or framework requirements still apply; these native minimums do not lower them.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m157. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

bullets.lead: Correct filtered images and glyph masks
bullets.detail: Keeps Ganesh sampling within image subsets under AA and MSAA, aligns image-filter cache equality with hashing, and uses fp32 displacement offsets to match filter bounds. Regenerated glyph masks use the correct outline and format, with full plane strides preserved for clipped embossed glyphs.

bullets.lead: Improve rasterization and GPU drawing correctness
bullets.detail: Fixes convex AA path overflow across vertical clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping and glyph-replay validation. Corrects reflected hairline square caps, transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles, text-atlas selection, and stale atlas work after empty Ganesh flushes.

bullets.lead: Correct Graphite and Vulkan edge cases
bullets.detail: Fixes Graphite readback stride, clip-key packing and wedge inflation. Clip-capacity accounting now skips draws whose clip stacks cannot fit. Vulkan fixes cover render-pass initialization, affected ARM driver device-loss cleanup timing and native synchronous wait results; managed GRContext.Submit remains void.

Generated LibraryImport declarations now select cdecl explicitly, matching existing DllImport and delegate paths across SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp and companion bindings. This addresses an ABI mismatch that can affect Windows x86; runtime verification of the reported optimized-call stack-growth symptom remains outstanding.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19: Release Candidate 2 corrects transformed Ganesh geometry, stale atlas work and Graphite clip-capacity accounting. It also improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling; managed GRContext.Submit remains void.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline square caps and GPU text-atlas selection. It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes, plus explicit cdecl metadata for LibraryImport declarations. Graphite Metal now requires iOS or tvOS 15, subject to any higher managed or framework minimum.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200 makes generated LibraryImport declarations explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing interop paths. This is a package revision, not an engine upgrade: bundled native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0, with no public binding signature changes.

v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.headline: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes.
v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.body: LibraryImport declarations explicitly select cdecl. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15, in addition to any higher framework requirements.

v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.headline: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and GPU text-atlas selection.
v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.body: It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers. These fixes do not change managed APIs.

v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.headline: Release Candidate 2 improves transformed GPU geometry, Graphite clipping and displacement-filter precision.
v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.body: It also corrects stale Ganesh atlas work and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling. GRContext.Submit remains void; no managed failure-reporting result is added.

v4.157.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 corrects filtered image subsets and mask-filtered glyph rendering.
v4.157.0.body: The stable cut prevents backing-texture pixels leaking into filtered images, aligns image-filter cache equality with hashing, and handles regenerated glyph formats and clipped mask planes correctly. These changes do not alter managed APIs.
